test_cases.scenario: Log in with correct email and password for an active account
preconditions: Active account exists for asha@example.com with password Valid#Pass1
User is logged out and on the login page
steps: Enter `email` from test data in the Email field
Enter `password` from test data in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the 'My Account' page and is logged in (reloading the page keeps them on 'My Account')

test_cases.scenario: Log in with a registered email and a wrong password
preconditions: Active account exists for asha@example.com with password Valid#Pass1
User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Invalid email or password' is shown, the user remains on the login page and is not logged in

test_cases.scenario: Log in with an email that is not registered
preconditions: No account exists for nobody@example.com
User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: The same message 'Invalid email or password' is shown (no hint that the email is unknown) and the user remains on the login page

test_cases.scenario: 'Log in' button is disabled when both fields are empty
preconditions: User opens the login page fresh (no autofill)
test_cases.expected_result: 'Log in' button is shown disabled and clicking it triggers no request and no navigation

test_cases.scenario: 'Log in' stays disabled when only one field is filled
preconditions: User is on the login page with both fields empty
steps: Enter only the email from case_a
Clear the email and enter only the password from case_b
test_cases.expected_result: In both case_a and case_b the 'Log in' button remains disabled

test_cases.scenario: 'Log in' enables once both fields are filled and disables again when one is cleared
preconditions: User is on the login page with both fields empty
test_cases.expected_result: The button becomes enabled after both fields are filled and becomes disabled again as soon as the password is cleared

test_cases.scenario: Email without '@' shows the inline format message
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Click 'Log in' (or move focus out of the Email field)
test_cases.expected_result: Inline message 'Enter a valid email address' is shown under the Email field and the user is not logged in

test_cases.scenario: Email with a missing domain part shows the inline format message
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Click 'Log in' (or move focus out of the Email field)
test_cases.expected_result: Inline message 'Enter a valid email address' is shown under the Email field and the user is not logged in

test_cases.scenario: Four consecutive failures do not lock the account
preconditions: Active account asha@example.com with 0 failed attempts
steps: Log in with `wrong_password` 4 times in a row
test_cases.expected_result: Each of the 4 failures shows 'Invalid email or password' (no lock message); the 5th attempt with the correct password redirects to 'My Account'

test_cases.scenario: Fifth consecutive failure locks the account
preconditions: Active account asha@example.com with 0 failed attempts
steps: Log in with `wrong_password` 5 times in a row
test_cases.expected_result: After the 5th attempt the message 'Your account is locked. Try again in 15 minutes.' is shown and the user is not logged in
postconditions: Account asha@example.com is locked for 15 minutes

test_cases.scenario: Correct password is rejected while the account is locked
preconditions: Account asha@example.com was locked by 5 failed attempts less than 1 minute ago
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Your account is locked. Try again in 15 minutes.' is shown and the user is not redirected to 'My Account'

test_cases.scenario: Account is still locked just before 15 minutes have passed
preconditions: Account asha@example.com was locked exactly 14 minutes 50 seconds ago (use a controllable clock or adjust the lock timestamp in the test environment)
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Your account is locked. Try again in 15 minutes.' is shown and the user is not logged in

preconditions: Account asha@example.com was locked 15 minutes 10 seconds ago
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the 'My Account' page

test_cases.scenario: Successful login resets the failed-attempt counter
preconditions: Active account asha@example.com with 0 failed attempts
test_cases.expected_result: The last 4 failures each show 'Invalid email or password' and no lock message appears, proving the counter restarted from 0 after the successful login

test_cases.scenario: Log in with the email in different letter case
preconditions: Active account registered as asha@example.com with password Valid#Pass1
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the 'My Account' page of the asha@example.com account

test_cases.scenario: Log in with a password of the minimum length (8 characters)
preconditions: Active account min8@example.com with an 8-character password
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the 'My Account' page

test_cases.scenario: Log in with a password of the maximum length (64 characters)
preconditions: Active account max64@example.com with a 64-character password
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the 'My Account' page (the password is not truncated)

gaps.description: Behaviour for passwords shorter than 8 or longer than 64 characters at login is not specified
gaps.reason: Assumption A-2; awaiting answer to Q-2

gaps.description: Whether failures with an unregistered or badly formatted email count towards the lock
Password case sensitivity, session duration and 'remember me' are not specified
gaps.reason: Not in US-101; not tested to avoid inventing requirements

coverage_summary.notes: All 6 acceptance criteria and both stated business rules are covered, with boundaries on the 5-attempt lock and its 15-minute duration. Cases TC-LOGIN-011/012/016/017 rely on assumptions A-1 and A-2. The main remaining risks are the unspecified lock-counting rules (Q-3) and password-length handling at login (Q-2).

requirements.text: A registered customer can log in with email and password to access their account

acceptance_criteria.text: Correct email and password for an active account redirects to the 'My Account' page
Incorrect email or password shows 'Invalid email or password' and the customer remains on the login page
'Log in' button is disabled until both email and password are non-empty
Invalid email format shows inline 'Enter a valid email address' under the field
After 5 consecutive failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes and 'Your account is locked. Try again in 15 minutes.' is shown

business_rules.text: A successful login resets the failed-attempt counter
While locked, a login with the correct password is also rejected with the lock message
